preregistration.name: HD 11964 b Milestone 29 held-out detector-v0.5 validation
preregistration.scientific_target: An intermittent narrowband signal coherent under the selected HD 11964 b motion hypothesis; the signal is not assumed to originate on the planet or to be aimed at Earth
preregistration.selection_rule: Advance HD 11964 at frozen discovery rank 28 after ranks 26 and 27 fail the fixed L-band cadence rule; search the sole complete compatible L-band cadence --66653 after all metadata and full-bank coverage checks pass.
preregistration.survey_scope: One complete GBT L-band alternating ON/control cadence, five frozen 1 MHz planet-frame windows, and detector v0.5.0. There is no second qualifying HD 11964 cadence, so this milestone cannot establish independent recurrence. The later rank 29 bet UMi cadence remains spectrally untouched. Telescope, bands, recurrence statistic, thresholds, spectral widths, orbital scale/phase bank, RFI mask, detector-v0.5 vetoes, empirical calibration, completeness procedure, and complete cluster retention remain frozen. The 1200-cluster report cap exceeds the finite maximum of 1008 pre-clustering peaks per window and cannot truncate a complete disposition record.

completeness.method: Real m29_1412p5 planet-frame noise vectors are independently circularly shifted by epoch; signals use time-averaged sinc-squared leakage and model acceleration within each integration.
completeness.ideal_snr_definition: Single-epoch S/N the same total signal power would produce as a stationary bin-centred one-channel tone.

interpretation_limits: This search covers 5 disjoint planet-frame bands totaling 5 MHz, not the full receiver band.
A null result constrains only signals present in at least two of the three epochs and represented by the orbital template bank.
The 1/3/5/9-channel boxcars approximate, but do not exactly match, every fractional-bin and acceleration-smeared line shape.
Completeness is measured for exact orbital-bank templates active in epochs 1 and 3; it is not yet marginalized over orbital-model error or every duty cycle.
When configured, the recurrence guard requires every claimed active epoch to exceed its stated single-epoch S/N floor.
The strong-single-epoch RFI mask and recurrence statistic were added after the first Milestone 7 diagnostic run; independent future bands are required for confirmation.
The per-epoch RFI mask follows each circularly shifted epoch in the empirical null and completeness trials.
Scramble p-values are empirical ranks with resolution 1/(N+1), not Gaussian sigma conversions.
